scope: Validation-only, fixed model and fixed global windows; no training, PV, test read, network-output change, or per-sample truth-based window selection

formulas.taylor: Fit Re F=a0+a2*x^2+a4*x^4 and Im F=b1*x+b3*x^3 on conjugate symmetric fixed windows x=K/Kmax. u=-b1/(a0*Kmax); E[v^2]=-2*a2/(a0*Kmax^2); T=m/e*(E[v^2]-u^2). Nonpositive a0 is invalid.
formulas.log_cumulant: Fit log|F|=a0+a2*x^2+a4*x^4; T=-(m/e)*2*a2/Kmax^2. This is an auxiliary characteristic-function estimator, not a repaired VDF.
formulas.sign_convention: F(K)=integral f(v) exp(-i*K*v)dv; K in s/m, velocity m/s, temperature eV.

reporting: All-finite MAE includes finite negative temperatures to prevent improved scores through exclusion. Separate nonnegative-only errors and invalid counts are provided. True Fourier estimates expose finite-window fit bias. No per-sample estimator or window is selected.
